XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Recovery mode ignition, engine overheating detected
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P17D8 | PROTECTION | SLOW | PERFORMANCE | EMERGENCY | TEMPERATURE | LOCK | THERMOSTAT | COOLING FAN |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine cooling circuit

  • Device: Engine cooling system water pump

  • Fault: The vehicle experiences a significant loss of power accompanied by engine overheating, causing the control unit to enter Limp Home mode.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P17D8 (Engine torque monitoring system, control limit exceeded)

  • Cause: Water pump blockage

• Action: Check and, if necessary, replace the water pump

  • Procedure:
      1. Initial check:
      • Check the coolant temperature sensor parameters using the diagnostic system.
      • Carry out a road test to assess the sensor’s behaviour.
      2. If the reading is too high:
      • Check the engine oil level and top up if necessary.
      • Using the diagnostic tool, activate the cooling fan.
      3. If the fan activates correctly:
      • Check the temperature of the fluid in the thermostat body outlet pipe.
      4. If the temperature is too low:
      • Remove the water pump.
      • Note: Do not disconnect the electrical wiring.
      • Using the diagnostic tool, activate the water pump control valve.
      5. Control valve test result:
      • If the valve is stuck, replace the water pump.
      • If the pump is working, check for any faults in the cooling system or the engine.
